description: A theme as its host has it (its themes folder's <name>/: manifest.json, theme.css, tokens.json, scene.json and its assets), worked out by the host for every app alike: the desktop apps draw its CSS over theirs and its colours, the phone its colours; a scene, every app.

manifest.description: Its manifest: as its manifest.json has it, or as its files make it (kind colours or skin) where it has none.

css.description: Its theme.css (GTK CSS, the desktop apps': drawn over all of theirs), empty if it has none.

light.description: Each colour of schema/tokens' libadwaita and baude groups the theme makes other than Baude's own in light, by its token's path: #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa where it's see-through. A colour made of another (baude.rule of libadwaita.borders) is here when that one's set.

dark.description: Each colour of schema/tokens' libadwaita and baude groups the theme makes other than Baude's own in dark, by its token's path: #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa where it's see-through. A colour made of another (baude.rule of libadwaita.borders) is here when that one's set.

scene.description: Its scene.json, checked: left out where it has none.

files.description: Each file in its folder, by its path (theme_file gets one).

code.description: Its code's sha256 (its desktop/ Python and shaders together, hex): left out where it has none.

trusted.description: Whether its code, as it is, is trusted to run on this host's machine (theme_trust).

error.description: Why its files can't be used, in place of the rest.
